request:
I run a small provisions shop in Madina and I want to keep my price list on the computer instead of in my notebook. I want to add the things I sell with their prices. I want to see everything I sell, and look up the price of one thing. Sometimes I stop selling something, so I want to take it off the list.

The client's answers to your questions:
Q: When a price goes up or down, do you want to be able to change the price of something already on the list, or would you remove it and add it again?
A: Change the price of the item already on the list; do not remove and re-add it.
Q: Do you sell the same thing in different sizes or amounts at different prices (for example, rice by the cup and by the bag)? If yes, should each size have its own price on the list?
A: No preference: you decide.
Q: When you look up a price, should typing part of the name (like "milk") show all matching things, or will you always type the full exact name?
A: No preference: you decide.
summary:
I've built your price list in a file called `app.py`, and all 6 of my tests pass. Your list is kept in a file called `price_list.db` in the same folder, so it's still there after you restart the program.

**What you can do:**
- **Add something you sell:** `POST /items` with a name and price, for example `{"name": "Peak Milk", "price": 15}`.
- **See everything you sell:** `GET /items` shows the whole list in A–Z order.
- **Look up a price by name:** `GET /items?search=milk` shows everything with "milk" in its name, such as Ideal Milk and Peak Milk. Part of a name is enough, and capital letters don't matter.
- **Look up one thing:** `GET /items/{id}` shows one item. Every item gets an ID number when you add it.
- **Change a price:** `PATCH /items/{id}` with the new price, for example `{"price": 18}`. The item stays on the list; only its price changes.
- **Take something off the list:** `DELETE /items/{id}`.

**What it refuses:**
- An item with the same name as one already on the list. "Bread" and "bread" count as the same name.
- An item with no name.
- A price that is missing, zero or negative.
- Looking up, changing or removing an item that isn't on the list.

**Two choices I made where you had no preference:**
- **Sizes:** If you sell something in more than one size, add each size as its own item with its own price, for example "Rice (cup)" and "Rice (bag)". A search for "rice" will then show both.
- **Searching:** Typing part of a name finds every match, so you don't need to type the full name.

**Other things to know:**
- Prices are rounded to 2 decimal places, as in cedis and pesewas.
- To run it, start it with `uvicorn app:app`.
